name: Crimson Viper
source:
Crimson Viper is a demonic ninja, equipped with super agility and extraordinary focus, who once protected the most notorious neighborhoods of the city. But, unsatisfied with her role as defender of the oppressed, she decided her mission needed to evolve. With a heart hardened by her twisted view of justice, she chose to attack the system, striking not only her enemies but also innocent citizens, including those she once swore to protect. Now, her revenge seems to know no bounds, and her figure is feared as much as it is hated.

[In game description]
